_: Name, description and badge live in src/resources/connectors.json so the console and the browser process cannot disagree about them.

notes: Read scopes only. Klaviyo sends marketing email; a token that can write campaigns is a token that can email a customer list by mistake, which is the least recoverable action in this whole catalogue.
The authorize host and the token host differ - www.klaviyo.com to authorise, a.klaviyo.com to exchange. Using one for both fails.
Every request needs the revision header; Klaviyo versions by date and omitting it pins you to an old shape.

personal_token.label: Private API key
personal_token.where: klaviyo.com > Settings > API keys > Create Private API Key, with read-only scopes selected.
notes: Klaviyo private keys support per-scope restriction, so a read-only key is genuinely read-only.

rate_limits.note: Per endpoint, as a burst and a steady rate. Returns 429 with Retry-After.
